Open to legal residents of California, age 18 or older, who own a residential property in Santa Barbara County that is the subject of their entry. Number of prizes: three (3). Every eligible entrant is entered in the drawing; there is no minimum or maximum number of entrants. Odds of winning depend on the number of eligible entries received.

5. Winner Announcement and Notification

Winners will be drawn on November 5, 2026 and announced at the ELITE Remodels Giveaway Drawing Party on Thursday, November 5, 2026, 5:30 pm, at 2267 Las Positas Rd., Santa Barbara, CA 93105. A message from ELITE founder, Jerry Jaimes

JERRY JAIMES
owner / general contractor

As founder and general contractor of ELITE Remodels, Jerry has built a company defined by precision, professionalism, and a genuine dedication to people’s homes and lives.

What began nearly 20 years ago as a small home-repair business has grown into a full-service design-and-build firm with an in-house team of nearly 20 experts, including certified designers, licensed tradespeople, and project managers. Together, they deliver what Jerry calls a “concierge approach to remodeling”—handling every detail from design and materials to construction and cleanup, all under one roof.

Jerry’s business model was originally inspired by a standout stay at a five-star hotel, where every staff member focused on delivering exceptional service. From kitchens and baths to complete home remodels, he aims to deliver that same excellence during each remodel: One team sharing the same values and goals, where craftsmanship meets care, where every project is built to last, and every client is treated like family!

“We don’t stop until our clients are 100% satisfied. That’s why we’re still here, still growing, and still raising our standards.” — Jerry Jaimes

GRACE
designer

A fifth generation Santa Barbara native, Grace’s father was in the building industry giving her a unique opportunity to witness many homes being constructed from the ground up. Describes Grace, “My dad would bring my siblings and me to his construction sites to see the progress. We were exposed not only to the design details but the actual work that went into building a new home.” Her early exposure to construction not only sparked her interest in architecture and construction but also provided her with invaluable hands-on experience that shaped her career path.

“Growing up in Santa Barbara, I've always appreciated our vibrant community, stunning architecture, and natural beauty.” Adds Grace, “I love helping others express their personality and creativity through their homes, and that makes my job so exciting!”

JANE
designer

With her rich history of world travel, cultural experiences, art, architecture, design and decor studies, Jane brings her broad aesthetic insights and passion to the field of home remodeling. She has specialized in custom cabinet design, designing for a broad scope of high-end to budget-conscious projects. Jane also spent nearly 20 years in the custom wood flooring industry collaborating with clients worldwide and catering to esteemed architects and design firms. One of her more well-known commercial projects is the Los Angeles County Museum of Art Resnick Pavilion, where she collaborated with Gensler, a global architecture, design, and planning firm, and Italian architect Renzo Piano. 

Jane enjoys all aspects of home design, especially helping clients achieve their remodeling dreams and goals. Says Jane, “Each project is as unique as each of my clients, and I love helping ensure every remodel is leading edge, while also being functional and aesthetically pleasing.”

Sign up for our monthly NEWSLETTER — serving up fresh news and remodels!
OCTOBER 1, 2026: We’re giving away over 60K in prizes!

This year we’re raising the stakes and giving away over $60,000 in total remodeling prizes to help turn your dream projects into reality! In this issue, ELITE Designer Grace gives us an exclusive peek inside our 2025 $10K bathroom winner’s remodel where warm, refined finishes and thoughtful details transform the space into a serene, spa-like retreat. Will you be our next winner? Enter by November 1st at remodelsbyelite.com. Or click the below button to go straight to our entry form. It’s fast, FREE, and easy!

ENTER REMODEL GIVEAWAY NOW!
SEPTEMBER 1, 2026: WIN huge prizes toward your dream remodel!

Last year, the Janci’s won $25,000 toward their kitchen remodel, and Beverly won $10,000 toward her bathroom remodel! Now we’re raising the stakes in our 2026 REMODEL GIVEAWAY. There’s no better time to remodel your home than now! Entry is FREE and now open at the below link! 

AUGUST 1, 2026: REFRESH your home with dialed in details!

Outdated fireplace dragging down your home’s image? Messy closets not cutting it? Mudroom lacking thoughtful design and storage? Then it’s time for a REFRESH! See inside this issue of the ELITE newsletter for quick fixes that will make your home shine in no time!

LEARN MORE
JULY 1, 2026: Still Cooking in the kitchen that came with your home? 

Then it’s time for a refresh! See inside this month’s issue as our designers unlock the easiest solutions for completely changing the vibe of your kitchen or bath. We can’t wait to help you refresh your space! 

DISCOVER REFRESH BY ELITE
JUNE 1, 2026: Introducing… REFRESH by ELITE!

Tired of your old kitchen or bathroom but don't want to go through a full remodel? Get a stunning makeover that finishes in WEEKS, instead of months with REFRESH by ELITE! Our in-house team handles everything — Design, Materials, and Construction.  You'll achieve flawless results fast — all while receiving the expert guidance and quality craftsmanship you expect from ELITE Remodels. Call us by August 31 to get a complimentary material selection session with one of our expert designers!

LEARN MORE!
MAY 1, 2026: Give Mom the Ultimate Mother’s Day Gift!

Our May issue takes an in-depth look at one of our recently completed remodels — an Italian Villa-style, quintessential Santa Barbara Mediterranean home. ELITE Designer Grace Gambetta gives us all the gorgeous details of this swoon-worthy project. Also inside, see how you can save $5,000 on kitchen cabinets and receive $2,000 off a new bathroom vanity until May 31 — because Mom deserves more than flowers for Mother’s Day! Now is the time to give her the ultimate gift of a gorgeous new kitchen or bathroom that feels like her own personal sanctuary! 

APRIL 1, 2026: YOUR DREAM HOME… Delivered! 

In this issue of our monthly remodel newsletter, we highlight our newly remodeled vans plus details about our team of professionals that deliver exceptional, full-service remodels all around Santa Barbara County. More than 15 years of excellence and hundreds of 5-star reviews later, we’re ready to make this the year we deliver your DREAM HOME! As always… No chasing contractors. No Surprise Costs. No chaos in your home. 

MARCH 1, 2026: RESET WITH A SPRING HOME REFRESH!

We love helping homeowners with compact kitchens and baths maximize every corner of space while expressing their individual style! ELITE Remodels Designer Grace Gambetta transformed this outdated Polo Field condo kitchen into a modern and highly functional kitchen loaded with California coastal style. See inside this month’s newsletter for details, and start planning your ELITE remodel today!

FEBRUARY 1, 2026: LOVE WHERE YOU LIVE AGAIN! 

It’s Valentine’s Season and there’s no better time to start your dream remodel, especially with the gifts we have planned for you! Start your projects with our savings on Kitchen and Bath remodels, and special date night perks designed to help you rekindle the love. Our newsletter also features can’t miss Valentine’s events in Santa Barbara, as well as a sneak peek into what’s on the horizon in home design for 2026!

JANUARY 1, 2026 | HAPPY NEW YEAR! 2026 is the year of your dream home!

If you’ve been thinking about remodeling this coming year, stay tuned because we promise to provide new offerings that will help you get started on creating a home you’ll fall in love with again in 2026! To kick things off, have a look inside our Winchester Canyon area remodel that elevated the owner’s dated kitchen. Also inside this month’s newsletter: Photos of our incredible Toy Drive that brought nearly 300 toys to children in need. The outpouring of community support was incredibly heartwarming. We wish you and yours a wonderful New Year!

SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION
DECEMBER 1, 2025 | TOY DRIVE, REMODEL GIVEAWAY WINNERS, AND MORE! 

November was a busy month at ELITE with our Remodel Giveaway bash, helping clients achieve their remodel dreams, and getting ready for the holidays by turning our attention to GIVING this season. See inside this issue for all the details and holiday event highlights around Santa Barbara!

SEE OFFERS
NOVEMBER 1, 2025 | WIN $25,000 IN CUSTOM KITCHEN CABINETS AND MORE! 

Get ready to fall in love with your home again by entering to win our huge Remodel Giveaway! You could win $25,000 in custom kitchen cabinets, or $10,000 toward your bath remodel! Enter to win by Monday, 11/10 and then join us for our Giveaway party at our showroom on Thursday, 11/13 at 5:30 PM with live music, tapas, and drinks! Also inside: Our first annual toy drive—”Tubs of Toys”—that will bring joy to children in need this holiday season!

ENTER TO WIN!
OCTOBER 1, 2025 | DREAMING OF A MODERN UPGRADE? 

ELITE Designer Andrea Fonseca spills all the stunning details for our Modern kitchen remodel in Solvang in this issue. Whether your style is Modern, Mid-Century, Mediterranean, Farmhouse, or something else, our designers bring your vision to life!

SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION
SEPTEMBER 1, 2025 | RELAXING & REJUVENATING IN WINE COUNTRY 

This month, we spoke to ELITE Designer Grace Gambetta about her recent bathroom refresh in Solvang. See all the delicious details in our newsletter:  Bathrooms so gorgeous we would spend all our time there! 

SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION
AUGUST 1, 2025 | WE’VE UPDATED OUR LOOK! 

From our logo, to our website, to our social media pages, and more, we were due for a refresh of our own! We hope you enjoy all the new home remodeling inspiration coming your way. Join the conversation on Facebook & Instagram and discover  inspiration on Pinterest — all @remodelsbyelite!  

SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION
JULY 1, 2025 | MID-CENTURY MAKEOVER!

When Dei and Kate purchased their Santa Barbara home in 2019, it retained all the original features from the early 60s, including yellow and blue Formica counters and tiles. While they also desired to update the kitchen, they prioritized modernizing the bathrooms first. ELITE designer, Andrea Fonseca, assisted Dei and Kate in refining their vision and implemented many space-saving solutions.

This center-of-home masterpiece combines style, practicality, and warmth. To bring this vision to life, ELITE Designer Grace Gambetta reimagined the layout to enhance flow and functionality. Charcoal toned Petro Negresco Quartzite is used for the perimeter counters; The island displays Cristallo Quartzite with luminous crystalline deposits; while neutral toned Quartz coordinates with the island in the show-stopping pantry.
